The '''Gorobei system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Atlas" /> It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gorobei/Legends|Gorobei]], the [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Frenk/Legends|Frenk]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Character Encyclopedia" />
